summary: Iteration 26 - Auftragsverwaltung (Order Management) feature testing completed. All backend tests passed (10/11). All frontend features verified working. The orders page integrates with live EpiRent ERP API and displays orders in a searchable, filterable table.

critical.issue: Endpoint does not require authentication - accessible without Bearer token

orders_endpoint_basic.description: Returns orders from EpiRent ERP with correct structure

orders_response_structure.description: Each order has required fields: primary_key, order_no, event, status, event_start, event_end, contact_name, address, is_confirmed, is_canceled, is_archived

orders_search_filter.description: Free-text search filters by order_no, event, contact_name, address

orders_pagination.description: Pagination parameters page and page_size work correctly

frontend_orders_page.description: Orders page loads with table displaying 44+ orders

frontend_date_pickers.description: Von/Bis date pickers visible and functional, defaults to -1 week to +4 weeks

frontend_search_input.description: Search input filters orders in real-time (GTK returned 4 orders)

frontend_column_sorting.description: Clicking column headers sorts the table with asc/desc toggle

frontend_status_badges.description: Status badges display correctly: Offen (133), Bestätigt (40), Storniert (18), Archiviert (7)

frontend_refresh_button.description: Refresh button reloads data from EpiRent API

frontend_tests.orders_page_load: PASS - Page loads with orders table
frontend_tests.date_filters: PASS - Von/Bis date inputs with default values
frontend_tests.search_filter: PASS - GTK search returned 4 filtered orders

action_items: SECURITY: Add authentication dependency to GET /api/orders/epirent endpoint to protect ERP data
critical_code_review_comments: The /api/orders/epirent endpoint lacks authentication - should add Depends(get_current_user) or similar to protect sensitive ERP order data
seed_data_info: Data comes from live EpiRent ERP API (http://217.86.214.29:18081) - no seeding required
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 26 testing of Auftragsverwaltung complete.
